purpose: Final engineering semantic retrieval gate for the working UC1 embedding configuration.
scope: Engineering model selection only. This is not a benchmark result.

design.query_style: Semantic policy-purpose paraphrases without canonical document titles, legal references, CELEX identifiers, or document IDs.
design.expected_target: Rank of the first retrieved chunk belonging to the pre-specified expected document.

engineering_acceptance_gate.note: These are pre-specified engineering sufficiency criteria, not thesis outcome metrics.

probes.query: EU policy for improving forest resilience, biodiversity and sustainable forest management toward 2030.
EU policy for protecting and restoring biodiversity and ecosystems by 2030.
EU rules governing greenhouse gas emissions and removals from land use, land-use change and forestry.
EU framework for coordinated forest policy actions and sustainable forest management during the earlier forest action planning period.
EU environmental policy framework setting long-term priority objectives for environmental action through 2030.
EU policy for strengthening resilience and preparedness for the impacts of climate change.
EU rules establishing how Member States design and implement strategic plans under the Common Agricultural Policy.
EU strategy for developing a sustainable circular bio-based economy using renewable biological resources.
